snippet.title: DEADWAVE Gameplay  Trailer | Arcade 3rd-Person Shooter Zombie Game
snippet.description:
DEADWAVE is a classic stylized third-person shooter with Ancient themed maps. Built by a solo indie developer, it drops you into striking locations from Egyptian sands to crumbling temples, where every fight turns into a desperate, chaotic last stand.

Along the Zombie game mode also resides typical multiplayer modes. In these Prop-Hunt shines with amazing party gameplay but if you want to get competitve, you can 1v1 your friend, play free-for-all or team deathmatch.

Play the Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4348000/DeadWave_Demo/
Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4347680/DEADWAVE/
